notes: Plant wind case P14_bouquet (Vase bouquet) written by scripts/build_plants.py: 10297 vase with 24855 and three 32606 flowers, and a second vase with 19119 and six 3742. Parts picked by constant name from data/categories/parts; frame LDU, -Y up, the case front faces -Z, ground (base top) at y = 0. The wind blows toward +X.

Joints: stem_a: flex_approx revolute about [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] through [-40.0, -90.0, -20.0] (flex_approx: the bar in the stud only allows a twist; the tilt stands in for the stem bending. 24855 bar in the vase's open stud (official 10297 vase)); head_a1: real revolute about [0.496731, -0.819152, 0.286789] through [-32.4248, -110.0004, -15.6265] (real: 32606 on a long 24855 pin (R2); spins about the pin); head_a2: real revolute about [-0.496731, -0.819152, 0.286789] through [-47.5752, -110.0004, -15.6265] (real: 32606 on a long 24855 pin (R2); spins about the pin); head_a3: real revolute about [0.0, -0.81915, -0.57358] through [-40.0, -110.0004, -28.747] (real: 32606 on a long 24855 pin (R2); spins about the pin); stem_b: real revolute about [0.0, -1.0, 0.0] through [40.0, -100.0, 20.0] (real: 19119 bar in the vase's open stud (same seat as the 24855 bar); turns about the bar); head_b1: real revolute about [-0.433013, -0.866025, 0.25] through [26.576607, -125.650848, 27.749999] (real: 3742 on a 19119 flower pin (R2); spins about the pin); head_b2: real revolute about [0.433014, -0.866024, 0.250001] through [53.42315, -125.650853, 27.749589] (real: 3742 on a 19119 flower pin (R2); spins about the pin); head_b3: real revolute about [-0.813798, -0.342019, -0.469846] through [19.655629, -111.550887, 8.254356] (real: 3742 on a 19119 flower pin (R2); spins about the pin); head_b4: real revolute about [0.0, -0.866024, -0.500002] through [40.000234, -125.650853, 4.500417] (real: 3742 on a 19119 flower pin (R2); spins about the pin); head_b5: real revolute about [0.0, -0.342019, 0.939693] through [39.999841, -111.550887, 43.491564] (real: 3742 on a 19119 flower pin (R2); spins about the pin); head_b6: real revolute about [0.813798, -0.342019, -0.469846] through [60.344532, -111.550884, 8.254079] (real: 3742 on a 19119 flower pin (R2); spins about the pin).

Real LEGO freedoms: head_a1, head_a2, head_a3, stem_b, head_b1, head_b2, head_b3, head_b4, head_b5, head_b6. flex_approx joints (rigid tilt standing in for bending plastic, range <= 0.17 rad): stem_a.

Sign convention by meaning (checked with the evaluator, kinematics.json): stem_a + = Stem A in its vase (flex_approx); + leans it downwind (+X); head_a1 + = Flower A1 on its pin (real); right-hand about the pin; head_a2 + = Flower A2 on its pin (real); right-hand about the pin; head_a3 + = Flower A3 on its pin (real); right-hand about the pin; stem_b + = Stem B in its vase (real); right-hand about up (-Y): + turns +X toward +Z; head_b1 + = Flower B1 on its pin (real); right-hand about the pin; head_b2 + = Flower B2 on its pin (real); right-hand about the pin; head_b3 + = Flower B3 on its pin (real); right-hand about the pin; head_b4 + = Flower B4 on its pin (real); right-hand about the pin; head_b5 + = Flower B5 on its pin (real); right-hand about the pin; head_b6 + = Flower B6 on its pin (real); right-hand about the pin.

Motion comes from wind clips (scripts/wind_clips.py): a damped-response approximation, not aerodynamics. Ranges are catalog choices narrowed by sampled clearance (scripts/blender/check_plants_clearance.py), not measured stops. Kinematic and transform checks do not prove collision-free or physically feasible motion.
